lead to: Insufficient sleep in adolescence can lead to lasting difficulties with concentration.
青少年期睡眠不足可能导致长期难以集中注意力。
A single flawed assumption can lead to systematic bias across the entire model.
一个有缺陷的假设可能导致整个模型的系统性偏差。
Pilot data suggest the intervention may lead to measurable gains in reading fluency.
试点数据表明，该干预可能带来阅读流利度上可测量的提升。
result in: Failure to document exclusions resulted in a request for retraction.
未能记录排除标准导致期刊提出撤稿要求。
Small rounding errors at each step resulted in a substantial deviation in the final estimate.
每步的微小舍入误差累积后，在最终估计值中造成了显著偏差。
The revised sampling frame is expected to result in more stable estimates.
修订后的抽样框架预计将产生更稳定的估计值。
result from: Most of the discrepancy results from differences in coding schemes between the two teams.
大部分差异源于两队编码方案的不同。
The seasonal pattern appears to result from temperature rather than rainfall.
这一季节性格局似乎源于温度而非降水量。
Delays in publication often result from reviewer disagreements rather than editorial backlog.
出版延误常常起因于审稿人分歧，而非编辑积压。
give rise to: The new measurement device gave rise to questions about comparability with earlier data.
新型测量设备引起了人们关于其与早期数据可比性的疑问。
Rapid urbanization has given rise to fresh challenges for public transport planning.
快速城市化给公共交通规划带来了新挑战。
Ambiguous definitions in the codebook gave rise to inconsistent coding.
编码手册中含义不清的定义导致了编码不一致。
carry out: The team carried out semi-structured interviews with thirty practitioners.
团队对 30 名从业者开展了半结构化访谈。
Replication studies carried out in different countries strengthened the original finding.
在不同国家开展的复现研究加强了原有结论的说服力。
Ethical approval is required before carrying out research with minors.
对未成年人开展研究之前须获得伦理批准。
take into account: The model takes into account both student background and school resources.
该模型同时考虑了学生背景与学校资源。
Reviewers should take into account the limited access to archives during the study period.
评审者应考虑到研究期间档案获取渠道有限这一点。
Failing to take into account attrition can bias longitudinal conclusions.
不把样本流失计算在内，可能使纵向结论产生偏差。

shed light on.en: The corpus data shed light on the grammar of academic hedging.
shed light on.zh: 语料库数据为学术模糊限制语的语法提供了新的启示。

shed light on: These interviews shed light on why teachers resist the reform.
这些访谈阐明了教师抵制改革的原因。
The mechanism remains poorly understood, and the study only partially sheds light on it.
该机制仍未被充分理解，本研究只是部分地阐明了这套机制。
in practice: In practice, random assignment is difficult in small-school settings.
在实践中，小学校情境下难以实现随机分组。
The policy sounds reasonable, but in practice it creates perverse incentives.
这一政策听起来合理，但实际上制造了反常的激励。
In practice, the two definitions converge on the same set of cases.
实际上，两种定义都指向同一组案例。
in principle: In principle, any open dataset may be reused with attribution.
原则上，任何开放数据集均可在注明出处后复用。
The method is sound in principle, though its execution is demanding.
该方法原则上成立，只是实施要求很高。
In principle the committee could reconsider the decision after new evidence.
原则上，委员会可在新证据出现后重新考虑该决定。
on average: On average, participants recalled thirty words after a single session.
平均而言，参与者在单次学习后能回忆 30 个词。
On average, the cohorts in the revised program outperformed the original sample.
平均而言，修订后项目中的组别表现优于原样本。
The two schemes cost about the same on average, but differ in variance.
两种方案平均成本大致相同，但方差不同。
in turn: Higher expectations improve effort, which in turn raises achievement.
更高的期望改善努力程度，进而提升成绩。
Trust influences cooperation, which in turn predicts long-term participation.
信任影响合作，而合作又反过来预测长期参与。
Each chapter draws on the previous one and, in turn, sets up the next.
每章依托前一章，继而引出下一章。
to some extent: The decline can be explained to some extent by changes in the birth rate.
这一下降在某种程度上可用出生率的变化来解释。
Both approaches capture the phenomenon to some extent.
两种方法都在一定程度上捕捉到了这一现象。
To some extent, the reviewers' disagreement reflects definitional ambiguity.
审稿人的分歧在某种程度上反映了定义的模糊性。

thereafter.en: Participants completed the survey; thereafter, they were reimbursed for their time.
thereafter.zh: 参与者完成问卷；此后，他们获得了时间酬金。

thereafter.en: The archive was cataloged in 1998 and closed to the public thereafter.
thereafter.zh: 该档案于 1998 年编目，此后即对公众关闭。

thereafter.en: Samples were frozen within an hour and analyzed thereafter.
thereafter.zh: 样本在一小时内冷冻，随后进行分析。

in that: The revised scale is superior in that it distinguishes two forms of motivation.
修订后的量表更为优越，因为它区分了两种动机。
This case differs from the others in that exposure was measured directly.
这一案例不同于其他案例之处在于，暴露程度是被直接测量的。
The argument is circular in that its conclusion presupposes its premise.
该论证是循环的，因为其结论预设了其前提。
in addition to: In addition to the main survey, the team conducted twelve expert interviews.
除主问卷外，团队还进行了 12 次专家访谈。

in addition to.en: In addition to summarizing the evidence, the report proposes a monitoring plan.
in addition to.zh: 该报告除总结证据外，还提出了监测方案。

in addition to: In addition to English, the database indexes sources in six languages.
该数据库除英文外还收录六种语言的文献索引。
such as: Exclusion criteria such as prior diagnosis were applied uniformly.
诸如既往诊断之类的排除标准一律适用。
Metrics such as precision and recall were reported for every model.
每个模型均报告了精确率与召回率等指标。
Structural barriers such as cost and distance limit participation.
成本与距离等结构性障碍限制了参与。

according to.en: According to the latest census, the region lost fifteen percent of its young adults.
according to.zh: 根据最新人口普查，该地区流失了 15% 的青年成年人。

according to: According to the authors, the discrepancy reflects sampling rather than measurement error.
据作者称，这一差异反映的是抽样而非测量误差。
The timeline was revised according to the reviewers' schedule.
时间表根据审稿人的日程作了修订。

instead of.en: We report medians instead of means to guard against outlier effects.
instead of.zh: 我们报告中位数而非均值，以防异常值影响。

instead of: Coding was done independently instead of by consensus.
编码是独立完成的，而不是通过协商一致。
Instead of discarding outliers, the team flagged them for inspection.
团队没有丢弃异常值，而是将其标记出来供核查。

as a result of.en: Enrollment rose sharply as a result of the fee waiver.
as a result of.zh: 由于免除了费用，注册人数大幅上升。

as a result of: As a result of the replication failures, the original claim was withdrawn.
由于复现实验失败，原有结论被撤回。
Three datasets were excluded as a result of incomplete metadata.
由于元数据不完整，三个数据集被排除。
apart from: Apart from two exceptions, every participant finished both sessions.
除两个例外，所有参与者都完成了两次测试。
Apart from its cost, the method offers few advantages over existing tools.
除成本外，该方法相较于现有工具几乎没有优势。
The results are sound; apart from that, only the sample size could be questioned.
结果是可靠的；除此之外，只有样本量可被质疑。
prior to: Prior to analysis, all sequences were checked for contamination.
分析之前，所有序列均作了污染物检查。
Written consent was obtained prior to any data collection.
在任何数据采集之前均取得了书面同意。
The codebook was pilot-tested prior to the main study.
编码手册在主研究之前经过了预测试。
relative to: Performance improved relative to the baseline measurement.
相对于基线测量，表现有所提高。
Rural schools are underfunded relative to their urban counterparts.
相对于城市学校，乡村学校经费不足。
The estimate is low relative to figures reported in meta-analyses.
该估计值相对于元分析报告的数字偏低。

on the one hand.en: On the one hand the design maximizes realism; on the other it sacrifices control.
on the one hand.zh: 这一设计一方面最大化了真实性，另一方面却牺牲了控制。

on the one hand: On the one hand, open data increase impact; on the other, they raise privacy risks.
开放数据一方面提升了影响力，另一方面也带来隐私风险。
The argument holds on the one hand but fails on the other.
这个论点在一方面成立，在另一方面却不然。
in contrast to: In contrast to the first cohort, the second showed no practice effect.
与第一组不同，第二组未显示出练习效应。

in contrast to.en: The present results, in contrast to earlier survey findings, differ markedly.
in contrast to.zh: 与早期调查结论相比，本次结果差异显著。

in contrast to.en: In contrast to laboratory studies, field data capture behavior in real settings.
in contrast to.zh: 与实验室研究相对照，实地数据捕捉的是真实情境中的行为。
